Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 19
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscalculated the lifespans, incorrectly stating Antonio Caggiano lived ≈89 years and Hardyal Singh ≈90 years. In fact, Antonio Caggiano (30 Jan 1889 – 23 Oct 1979) lived a bit over 90 years, while Hardyal Singh (28 Nov 1928 – 17 Aug 2018) lived about 89 years. This arithmetic error led to the wrong conclusion that Hardyal Singh lived longer.
